scope: Gap research #2 for Fuobe's open ComfyUI engine: TTS/voice, video extend/reframe/relight/trajectory/multi-shot, character LoRA training, storyboards, video matting/depth, palette control. Companion to comfyui-oss.json (capability rankings) and workflows/comfyui/manifest.json (built library).

conventions.graph: ComfyUI API format (POST /prompt body.prompt). Links are [nodeId, outputSlot]. Placeholder file names in LoadImage/LoadAudio/LoadVideo are replaced by uploads.
conventions.bindings: canonical key -> list of {node, input} (same shape as workflows/comfyui/manifest.json; a key may set several nodes). All targets are literal inputs, never links. Keys beyond src/lib/comfy.ts BindingKey (text, voiceAudio, voiceAudio2, tracks, contextFrames, ...) are passed through ProviderInput.extra.
conventions.nodes: class_type input specs dumped from the live /object_info of the validation server (ComfyUI fc04da91 + the node packs listed in nodePack/extraNodePacks), so names/types/defaults/options are exactly what the server accepts. Long option lists are truncated.
conventions.models.sizeGB: decimal GB from the Hugging Face tree API; null = not resolvable. folder 'custom (...)' = node-managed auto-download location.
conventions.validation.postPrompt: true = POST /prompt accepted with HTTP 200, a prompt_id and no node_errors on ComfyUI fc04da91 (CPU, zero-byte placeholder weights, never executed). null = pack not installed there; graph transcribed from source only.
conventions.verified: true = node schemas read from source AND the recommended graph passed live /prompt validation; semantics that could only be inferred are listed in 'inferred'.

capabilities.title: Video extend (continue an existing clip)
capabilities.summary: Best commercially clean option: Wan 2.2 Fun VACE A14B continuation - the last N frames of the clip are passed as known VACE frames (mask 0) and the rest is generated (mask 1), then KJNodes ImageBatchExtendWithOverlap cross-fades the overlap. SVI 2.0 Pro (Wan 2.2 I2V + SVI LoRAs, MIT) is the long-form pick with less drift over many chunks; Wan 2.2 I2V with a multi-frame start_image is the zero-new-model fallback.

recommended.name: Wan 2.2 Fun VACE A14B context-frame continuation (+ lightx2v 4-step) with overlap blend
recommended.officialTemplate: pattern from template_sirolim_seamless_loop / video_wan_vace_* (WanVaceToVideo control_video + control_masks)

recommended.notes: Derived keys: newFrames = frames - contextFrames, contextFramesNegative = -contextFrames (ImageFromBatch accepts negative batch_index = from the end; verified in comfy_extras/nodes_images.py). Output = original clip (resized to width x height) + new frames, overlap linear-blended; each run adds frames-contextFrames frames (65 = ~4 s at 16 fps) - loop the job for longer. Input clip should be 16 fps (Wan native); resample client-side first. Mask colors: EmptyImage color 8355711 = 0x7F7F7F gray fill, 0 = keep, 16777215 = generate (ImageToMask red channel).

uiApi.base: http://<host>:8675 (npm run build_and_start in ui/; worker + Next.js on 8675)
uiApi.auth: if env AI_TOOLKIT_AUTH is set, every /api/* call needs 'Authorization: Bearer <AI_TOOLKIT_AUTH>' (ui/src/middleware.ts); /api/img, /api/files, /api/audio/art are public
uiApi.create: POST /api/jobs {name, gpu_ids: '0', job_config: <job object as in jobConfigs>} -> job row {id, ...} (409 if name exists)
uiApi.start: GET /api/jobs/<id>/start (puts job in queue, ensures queue for gpu is running)

headless.dataset: folder of jpg/jpeg/png + same-name .txt captions (img01.jpg + img01.txt); webp unsupported; no cropping needed (aspect buckets, never upscaled). Put '[trigger]' in captions and set trigger_word, or write the token directly. 15-30 varied photos (face close-ups, half/full body, different light/outfits), captions describe everything except identity ('photo of fuobechar woman, wearing a red coat, street at night'). Auto-caption: /api/img/caption (UI) or Fuobe's prompt-enhance (Qwen3-VL TextGenerate).
headless.typical: rank 16-32, lr 1e-4, 2000-3000 steps at batch 1, save every 500 and keep the best checkpoint by sample review; Z-Image Turbo 1500-2500 steps (adapter v2), Wan 2.2 2000-3000 steps on stills (num_frames 1) or short clips
headless.output: <training_folder>/<name>/<name>.safetensors (+ step checkpoints) -> copy to ComfyUI models/loras/fuobe/<userId>/ and inject LoraLoaderModelOnly (Fuobe's injectLoras)

recommended.notes: Arch names are the UI arch ids (model.arch 'zimage:turbo' is split at ':' -> 'zimage' in toolkit/config_modules.py; the UI variant only changes defaults). Z-Image Turbo requires assistant_lora_path = ostris/zimage_turbo_training_adapter v2 (de-distill adapter, training-only) so the distilled model can be trained; the saved LoRA is applied to z_image_turbo at inference. VRAM (low_vram + qfloat8): Z-Image ~16-24 GB, Qwen-Image-2512 24 GB with uint3 ARA, FLUX 3 Klein base ~24 GB, Wan 2.2 14B 24 GB with uint4 ARA (both experts, switch_boundary_every 10).
inferred: VRAM numbers are ai-toolkit preset targets ('24gb' configs, low_vram presets), not measured

alternatives.name: ComfyUI core TrainLoraNode (Z-Image Turbo, LoadImageTextDataSetFromFolder -> MakeTrainingDataset -> TrainLoraNode -> SaveLoRA)
alternatives.notes: Dataset = ComfyUI input/<folder>/ with img + same-name .txt (LoadImageTextDataSetFromFolder lists input subfolders). TrainLoraNode is experimental, is_input_list; options: optimizer AdamW/Adam/SGD/RMSprop, loss MSE/L1/Huber/SmoothL1, algorithm LoRA/LoHa/LoKr/OFT, gradient_checkpointing, offloading, bucket_mode, existing_lora (resume). SaveLoRA writes output/<prefix>_<steps>_steps_<counter>_.safetensors (ComfyUI output dir, not models/loras - move it). Training a distilled Turbo model without a de-distill adapter degrades it; prefer Z-Image (base) for training then apply to Turbo.

capabilities.title: Video background removal / alpha matte
capabilities.summary: Core RemoveBackground + BiRefNet (MIT) processes IMAGE batches frame by frame (verified: comfy/bg_removal_model.py loops over the batch), JoinImageWithAlpha builds RGBA and core SaveWEBM writes VP9 yuva420p with real transparency. For 'remove everything except <object>' use SAM 3.1 video tracking (core SAM3_VideoTrack, text-prompted, temporally consistent).

recommended.name: BiRefNet per-frame matte (core RemoveBackground) -> RGBA WebM (VP9 alpha) + matte MP4
recommended.notes: Outputs: node 7 = transparent .webm (SaveWEBM: 'RGBA images are saved with their alpha channel as transparency (vp9 codec only)', reported under ui.images with animated preview), node 10 = black/white matte .mp4 for compositing. RemoveBackground returns foreground=1; InvertMask is required because JoinImageWithAlpha stores 1-mask as alpha (same as the library's bg-remove-birefnet). fps on SaveWEBM is a literal (bind source fps). Edge flicker is possible on hair; Comfy-Org/BiRefNet also ships lucida.safetensors (0.88 GB); the core loader only accepts BiRefNet-architecture keys (comfy/bg_removal_model.py), so whether lucida loads is unverified.

capabilities.title: Color palette control (Soul HEX parity)
capabilities.summary: Two layers: (1) generation - FLUX.2 understands hex codes in prompts (BFL prompting guide: 'FLUX.2 supports precise color matching using hex codes'), so palette presets become prompt text on flux2-dev-t2i (NC) or FLUX.2 klein (Apache, inferred to share the behaviour); (2) deterministic lock - core ColorTransfer (reinhard_lab | mkl_lab | histogram) maps any generated image or video onto a palette swatch image rendered client-side.

recommended.name: Palette lock: core ColorTransfer against a client-rendered swatch (post-process any image/video)
recommended.notes: image = generated result, image2 = palette swatch PNG the app renders from the HEX list (e.g. 512x512 vertical bands weighted by intended coverage). ColorTransfer(image_target, image_ref, method, source_stats=per_frame|uniform|target_frame (+source_stats.target_index), strength 0-10). For video use source_stats='uniform' to avoid per-frame flicker (pools stats across frames). Pair with prompt hex codes for semantic placement ('the jacket in color #E4572E'). Fully deterministic client-side alternative: k-means palette extraction + LAB histogram matching in a WebGL/canvas pass.
